sources.title: Qwen3-Max: Just Scale it
sources.evidence: Official article dated September 24, 2025 identifies Qwen3-Max, describes its base as over one trillion parameters and MoE, and introduces Instruct through Alibaba Cloud and Qwen Chat. Read through indexed primary-page content; direct page rendering returned no text.

sources.title: Newly released models
sources.evidence: Release table explicitly dates qwen3-max and qwen3-max-2025-09-23 to September 24, 2025; January 23, 2026 snapshot adds integrated thinking/non-thinking modes and tool capabilities.

sources.title: Model pricing
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Current pricing documentation explicitly maps qwen3-max to qwen3-max-2026-01-23 in multiple regions and lists thinking/non-thinking support. It supplies no total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Text generation models
sources.evidence: Indexed primary documentation dated September 11, 2026 lists qwen3-max with 256k context, thinking, function calling and structured output. This is historical documentation; the direct non-trailing-slash page has since been revised.

sources.title: AI inference fees
sources.evidence: qwen3-max is explicitly text-input-only and used for content generation. Its fee table includes text output in thinking and non-thinking modes, and input tiers through 258,048 tokens. The page marks it as sunsetting soon.

sources.title: Pushing Qwen3-Max-Thinking Beyond its Limits
sources.evidence: Reopened indexed primary article October 27, 2026; direct Qwen rendering yields no text. January 25 announcement identifies Qwen3-Max-Thinking as API qwen3-max-2026-01-23. The article discusses parameter scaling, reinforcement learning and test-time scaling but supplies neither a scalar total nor an activated-parameter count.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork
sources.evidence: August 2026 announcement explicitly calls Qwen3.8-Max the first Max-class model whose weights will be opened, corroborating the earlier Qwen3-Max hosted release rather than an open checkpoint. Its 2.4T/95B figures do not apply to Qwen3-Max.

sources.title: Qwen3-Max exact model and snapshot specifications
sources.evidence: Parent read the complete indexed primary page, including separately titled qwen3-max-preview and January2026 sections. Both explicitly list262144 context. Preview tables mark Function Calling unsupported across regions; the main alias supports it in Beijing. Direct parser exceeded size limit; current endpoint operation was not tested.

sources.title: Alibaba Cloud’s Apsara Conference 2025: Full Stack AI + Cloud Leads the Way to the Future of AI
sources.evidence: September 29, 2025 corporate release calls Qwen3-Max a trillion-parameter model. Reopened through indexed primary content October 27, 2026 after direct fetch timed out. This supports the published scale, while the more specific Qwen and later Thinking statements preserve a strict greater-than-one-trillion bound.

sources.title: Alibaba’s Latest Thinking Model Excels at Adaptive Tool Use
sources.evidence: January 27, 2026 developer-owned newsroom article explicitly attributes over 1 trillion parameters to Qwen3-Max-Thinking itself and says its API is available through Model Studio. Reopened indexed primary article October 27, 2026; direct fetch returned 403. This extends the disclosed lower bound to the January snapshot, rather than relying only on the September base model. No active count is stated.

sources.title: Qwen3.5: Towards Native Multimodal Agents
sources.evidence: February 15, 2026 primary post, reopened in indexed primary content October 27. Its pretraining section describes Qwen3-Max-Base as >1T parameters and compares Qwen3.5 throughput against Qwen3-Max. The language benchmark table includes Qwen3-Max-Thinking, but no active parameter count for that model was recovered. The disclosed 397B total and 17B active counts belong to Qwen3.5 and cannot be transferred to Qwen3-Max.

name.note: Official styling is Qwen3-Max; baseline spacing is a display convention.

developer.note: Qwen Team model released through Alibaba Cloud.

release_date.note: The official release log lists September23 availability in China; global/international availability and blog publication followed September24.

open_weights.note: Hosted API/chat release; subsequent official announcement identifies Qwen3.8-Max as the first Max-class open-weight release. No open checkpoint equivalence is asserted.

license.note: No downloadable-weight license applies to this hosted release. API service terms are distinct.

parameters_b.note: The developer discloses over 1,000B parameters for Qwen3-Max-Base and explicitly for Qwen3-Max-Thinking, the January 23 snapshot currently behind this alias. The strict lower bound is verified and proposed separately; the scalar remains null because no point estimate is published. Alibaba’s less precise trillion-parameter description does not erase the greater-than qualifier.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately published active count was found after rechecking the exact-model announcements, January Thinking release and later Qwen3.5 comparison, plus targeted first-party active/activated-parameter searches. Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.8-Max counts describe different models.

architecture.note: The original Qwen3-Max base architecture is explicitly MoE. Current alias documentation supplies no detailed architecture revision/configuration.

context_window.note: Exact262144 context appears in the separately named model section of the indexed primary card; no inference from rounded256k.

modalities.note: Exact hosted model is text-input-only and generates text; chat application media features are not model modalities.

reasoning.note: Current documented qwen3-max alias resolves to the January 2026 thinking-capable snapshot; false describes the original September snapshot only.

tool_call.note: Official exact-model documentation supports function calling and tool-using agents.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3 text model for coding, reasoning, and tool-using agents.
description.note: Removes time-sensitive flagship wording and reflects current documented alias capabilities.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3 text model for coding, reasoning, and tool-using agents.
patch.notes: First documented China availability is September 23, 2025; global rollout and launch post followed September 24. The alias maps to the January 23, 2026 Thinking snapshot. Alibaba discloses over 1,000B total parameters for both the original base and this Thinking model; this is a strict lower bound, not a 1,000B point estimate. Active parameters are undisclosed. Exact context is 262144 in the indexed model card.

sources.label: Alibaba Cloud alias mapping and modes
Official exact model and snapshot specifications

summary: Fresh parameter audit verifies the developer-published strict total bound above 1,000B for Qwen3-Max-Thinking, which is the current alias target, as well as the original base. Proposed explicit lower-bound fields preserve this supported size; no scalar point estimate or active count was found. Other prior field assessments are preserved.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Verified strict total lower bound above 1,000B for current alias target; active count remains undisclosed.
parameter_reaudit.schema_note: Existing schema supports scalar counts and component/phase scopes, but no numeric bound. Proposed lower-bound and exclusivity fields preserve the developer disclosure without converting it to a point estimate. Parent must add schema/application/display support before accepting these proposed fields.
